text: Your conversation with {name} is interrupted by her aunt Dracina.  The old Klast used to run the clothing group and was generally feared and hated by all who came in contact with her.  Old age has not mellowed Dracina; she is still a  tyrant.  She gives you hardly a glance and proceeds to converse with {name} in Klast. This is in itself quite an insult, as it is long-established convention that eeyal is the only proper language to use in mixed groups, unless pragmatic reasons require the greater precision and expressiveness of a local language. You shrug off the insult, for Dracina is chewing out {name} over some infraction.  {name} herself is obviously embarrassed by her aunt's intrusion at a very delicate moment and seems to be trying to placate her and get rid of her.  Dracina, however, seems determined to press her point; an ugly family fight seems about to explode.  What do you do?

options.title: Nervously wait and see what happens.
results: Sure enough, a fight ensues; {name} bursts into tears and her aunt storms out.

options.title: Excuse yourself to another part of the house and wait there.
results: You can hear them squabbling for a while; then {name} comes, apologizes, and you both try to pick up where you left off.

options.title: Tell Dracina that her conversation with {name} can wait until later.
results: Dracina is outraged; she tongue-lashes you in Klast and stomps out.  {name} smiles appreciatively.

options.title: Ask {name} if she will allow her aunt to interfere with campaign business.
results: {name} looks chastened; her aunt continues to carp for a while and then leaves.
